t.zh: 改过输出尺寸后，题目直接给出原图中的采样位置。用<wiki-ref to="nearest-neighbour-interpolation"></wiki-ref>完成这次读取，比较 0.4 和 0.5 附近的结果。本题约定距离相同时取坐标较大的一边，图外取最近边界。
t.en: After changing output size, the task supplies sample positions in the original. Use <wiki-ref to="nearest-neighbour-interpolation"></wiki-ref> and compare positions around 0.4 and 0.5. Ties take the larger coordinate and positions outside use the nearest boundary.

after.zh: 位置只移动一点，读到的值却可能突然改变；这种不连续来自所选邻居的切换。取样规则决定了新图的结构，坐标正确并不保证放大后平滑。
after.en: A tiny position change can cause a sudden value change when the selected neighbour switches. The sampling rule determines the new image structure; correct coordinates alone do not ensure a smooth enlargement.

brief.zh: 这一行在 x = −0.25、0.4、0.5、1.6、2.2 处取值：写出每个位置最近的<wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref>的值。
brief.en: Read this row at x = −0.25, 0.4, 0.5, 1.6 and 2.2: write the value of the <wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref> nearest each position.

hint.zh: 0.5 离 0 和 1 一样近；2.2 最近的<wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref>是哪个？
hint.en: 0.5 is as near 0 as 1; which <wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref> is nearest 2.2?

why.zh: 这是一律向下取整：1.6 离 2 比离 1 近，却取了 1 的值；0.5 离两边一样近，按约定取 1。最近的整数是加 0.5 再向下取整。
why.en: That rounds every position down: 1.6 is nearer 2 than 1 but read 1; 0.5 is equally near both and by the convention reads 1. The nearest whole number is add 0.5, then round down.

t.zh: 位置用两张<wiki-ref to="coordinate-image"></wiki-ref>给出：x 图每格是要取的横坐标，y 图是纵坐标。新元件<part-ref to="part:floor"></part-ref>把数向下取整；<part-ref to="part:lookup"></part-ref>可以在元件上设成出界取最近的边。
t.en: The positions come as two coordinate images: each cell of x is the column to read, of y the row. New part: <part-ref to="part:floor"></part-ref> rounds down; <part-ref to="part:lookup"></part-ref> can be set on the part to read the nearest edge outside the image. (<wiki-ref to="coordinate-image"></wiki-ref>)

brief.zh: 输入一张图和两张<wiki-ref to="coordinate-image"></wiki-ref> x、y：交出每个位置最近的<wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref>的值。
brief.en: Given an image and the coordinate images x and y, give the value of the <wiki-ref to="pixel"></wiki-ref> nearest each position. (<wiki-ref to="coordinate-image"></wiki-ref>)

hint.zh: 手算时你是怎样从 1.6 得到 2 的？
hint.en: By hand, how did you get from 1.6 to 2?
